name: PP1 Mathematical Activities: Counting objects 1-5
subject: Mathematical Activities
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to count objects up to 5
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to match numbers 1-5 to groups of objects
learningActivities: Counting song: learners sing and clap while counting from 1 to 5
Concrete counting: learners count bottle tops, stones and sticks on their desks
Number cards: learners match number cards to groups of objects
Class game: 'count and sit' - learners count objects and sit when they reach 5
keyPoints: Counting means saying numbers in order to find how many
The last number counted tells how many objects there are
Numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 must be said in the correct order
commonMisconceptions: Rote counting without touching or pointing at objects
lessonEvaluation: Learners count groups of objects up to 5 and match them to number cards. Teacher observes and records.
teacherReflection: Most learners counted confidently. A few needed help pointing at each object as they counted.
